layout: solar(20,101,0) fixed DOWN output -> initially empty cube(20,100,0), INPUT_OUTPUT and eject enabled -> cable(21,100,0) -> initially empty smelter(22,100,0)
Separate precharged cube(0,100,0)->cable(1,100,0)->smelter(2,100,0) retains the existing storage-output check.
source_owner: TileEntitySolarGenerator.getEnergySides returns BOTTOM; TileEntityGenerator.onUpdateServer calls CableUtils.emit; there is no side-configuration component to invent.
units: NBT energy_containers.stored is Mekanism joules, not FE.
checks: PASS the energy cube still holds a charge after feeding the cable
PASS the smelter was charged through the cable
PASS the initially empty cube received solar energy from above
PASS the unseeded smelter received solar energy via cube and cable
limits: Induction matrix capacity/flow not verified by this rig. A casing shell remaining readable is not formation proof; the previous vacuous assertion was removed.
This proves source-to-machine transfer, not whole-chain lossless accounting including cable buffers and time-varying solar output.
process_lifecycle: dedicated JVM owns a setsid process group, command FIFO, readiness and sprint markers; graceful stop, wait and failure cleanup with group verification. No owned game client started by this script.
